info.description: REST API untuk sistem Point of Sale Mentai Mental
info.title: POS Mentai Mental API

get.description: Get transaction count distribution grouped by hour of day for completed transactions
Get sales total and quantity sold grouped by product category
Get customers ranked by total spending amount
Get total sales, transaction counts, low stock counts, and top products
Get sales total and transaction counts grouped by payment method
Calculate average consumption rate over past 7 days to estimate deplete dates
Get sales and order counts trend over the last N days or custom range, grouped by daily or monthly period

Blacklist the current JWT access token to invalidate the session

get.description: Get current authenticated user profile details

post.description: Generate a new access token using a valid refresh token

get.description: Get a list of all product categories

delete.description: Delete a product category from the system

get.description: Get a list of all registered customers sorted by name

post.description: Register a new customer for loyalty spent tracking

get.description: Get total transactions, total spent, and basic details of a customer

put.description: Modify name or phone number of a customer

delete.description: Remove customer profile from the system

get.description: Get a list of all raw ingredients and their current stock levels

post.description: Add a new raw ingredient to inventory catalog

get.description: Get a log of all incoming and outgoing stock transactions
Get current stock, unit, and threshold for a single ingredient

put.description: Update unit, threshold, or base stock values

get.description: Get a list of all products, optionally filtered by name search, category, or active status

Get a list of raw ingredients and quantities required for a single product

Validate signature key and update transaction status to Paid/Failed

Format transaction receipt and trigger local WhatsApp gateway

get.description: Get a list of all user accounts (owner-only)

post.description: Create a new cashier, staff, or owner user account with a hashed password

get.description: Get information of a single user account

put.description: Update user profile details, roles, or change passwords
